Disco Devotion

Disco Devotion is a high-energy 6-piece delivering dazzling disco, soul, funk & pop hits with pitch-perfect vocals, smooth musicianship & serious feel-good vibe

About Disco Devotion

Disco Devotion is a powerhouse 6-piece band serving up the ultimate blend of disco, soul, funk, and pop to keep your dance floor full from the very first beat. Since their debut for HM Forces in 2021 , they’ve been wowing crowds nationwide with dynamic performances and glowing client reviews. Fronted by Kedesha and Gemma , this vocal duo brings the best of both worlds— soulful power and pop precision —all tied together with infectious energy and slick harmonies. With subtle choreography , stellar crowd connection, and years of combined experience, they truly shine on stage. They’re backed by David (guitar) , Ewan (bass + BVs) , Cyrus (keys) , and Eduardo (drums + BVs) —a rock-solid rhythm section trained at BIMM, Brit School , and Leeds Met . The band’s extensive CV includes festivals, international tours, cruise residencies, and legendary venues from Ronnie Scott’s to the Royal Albert Hall . With 650+ songs , full PA &amp; lighting , and tailored setlists, Disco Devotion delivers a dancefloor-ready show every single time.
